notes: TEMPLATE for `steerlab-server sae qualification record --inputs <this> --artifact runs/<run>/<name>`. Copy into the study WORKSPACE and replace every value. Constructs, metric names, and thresholds are DATA: nothing in the engine knows what a good number is here, and no verdict is computed from these rows — `decision` is the researcher's, recorded with its rationale. The engine checks shape, dose-grid coverage, that `doseResponse` claims nothing the `constructProbe` rows do not show (a declared monotone or sign-symmetric ladder must be one in these rows, by the same dose-monotonicity test `promote` applies to every vector family), and that `feature` matches the cited artifact's own gemmascopeSource (the decoderRowHash above all). Keys are CLOSED; `artifact`, `recordedAt`, `recordedBy`, and `substrate` are stamped by the verb and must NOT appear here.

constructProbe.heldOutSetHash: sha256 of the held-out probe file
constructProbe.notes: The construct measure, on data the feature was never chosen against.

lexicalLeakage.metric: rate of the feature label and its closest lexical synonyms
lexicalLeakage.notes: The effect must not be exhausted by repeating the label.

discriminantControls.construct: the neighbouring construct that must NOT move
discriminantControls.metric: held-out endorsement rate for that construct
discriminantControls.notes: An empty discriminantControls array is the way to say none were run.

coherenceGate.notes: No coherence collapse, no format collapse, no dose-dependent missingness at the selected dose.

doseResponse.summary: Directionally stable across the ladder and separated from matched-norm random at the middle and high doses.

decision.rationale: REPLACE — say what the numbers showed and which gate was closest to failing.

evidenceRuns.label: study-a
evidenceRuns.describes: dose ladder, both signs, matched-norm random controls
